_comment: SAMPLE: replace per client. 'howItWorks' feeds the How Booking Works section; 'formSteps' labels the booking form's progress indicator, in order.

howItWorks.title: Choose court and time
howItWorks.text: Pick a court, or any indoor or outdoor court, then a date, a start time and 1 to 3 hours.

howItWorks.title: Enter your details
howItWorks.text: Your name, mobile number and email, so our staff can reach you about the request.

howItWorks.title: Pay via GCash
howItWorks.text: Send the exact amount to our GCash account. The QR code and number are on the payment step.

howItWorks.title: Upload proof
howItWorks.text: Add a screenshot of your GCash receipt and its 13-digit reference number.

howItWorks.title: Submit
howItWorks.text: You get a booking code, and your request goes to our staff as Pending Review.

howItWorks.title: Wait for confirmation
howItWorks.text: Staff check the payment, then confirm or reject the request by email and SMS.
